Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan.   • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. Chart abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  • Provide customer-facing IT support; own support channels via Slack, Jira, etc.; manage Mac endpoints and enterprise macOS deployments.

  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents; prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Experience creating automations with Bash, Zsh, Python; using open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows; strong API integration skills; remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and calmly; strong ticketing and documentation skills.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting and macOS enterprise environments; strong networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing); understanding OSI model layers and methodical troubleshooting; self-management and multi-team coordination.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; ability to handle ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience using GAM and CLI tools; Jamf and Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment with values alignment.

Benefits and What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity; remote work eligibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).

Ledn is globally distributed with a remote-first environment. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

Transformando mercados com tecnologia há mais de 30 anos. Nós impactamos vidas através da Tecnologia.

Fomos pioneiros na digitalização da Justiça brasileira e seguimos expandindo os limites do que é possível com Inteligência Artificial.

Estamos desenvolvendo um produto de alto impacto para a Justiça , que combina IA generativa, segurança de dados e arquitetura escalável para apoiar magistrados e tribunais em decisões mais céleres, consistentes e explicáveis.

É um desafio inédito: aplicar IA de ponta em escala nacional, com rigor técnico, responsabilidade e impacto direto na vida de milhões de cidadãos.

Além da engenharia, buscamos alguém com perfil de evangelização técnica — capaz de documentar entregas e descobertas, apresentar resultados em fóruns internos e externos, compartilhar boas práticas e contribuir para disseminar uma cultura de IA ética, segura e orientada a impacto.

Você fará parte da equipe que está construindo uma das arquiteturas de IA mais avançadas já aplicadas ao sistema de Justiça .

O projeto combina múltiplas camadas tecnológicas, vetorização semântica, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), multi-LLMs e pipelines distribuídos, para compreender grandes volumes de dados jurídicos de forma segura e explicável.

O impacto vai além da tecnologia: cada decisão apoiada pela nossa IA pode representar mais eficiência, menos morosidade e mais acesso à Justiça para a sociedade.

É uma jornada que une ciência de dados, engenharia de alta performance e ética no uso da IA, buscando profissionais que queiram atuar na fronteira entre inovação tecnológica e transformação pública.

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de IA do produto, garantindo escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e explicabilidade.
  • Liderar iniciativas com LLMs, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para geração de soluções seguras e contextualizadas.

  • Garantir compliance e anonimização de dados sensíveis , em linha com LGPD e regulamentações do setor público.
  • Contribuir com o desenho e evolução da arquitetura distribuída (multi-workers/processors) conectada a sistemas judiciais e múltiplos LLMs.
  • Conhecimento em estatística, probabilidade e algoritmos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clusterização etc.).
  • Experiência prática com Grandes Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) e técnicas de prompting, embeddings e RAG.

  • Sólida base em Python e Node/TypeScript para automações e integrações.

Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds, guided by core values: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about innovation, creative problem solving, and adaptable to the changing corporate infrastructure landscape. You will be a motivated, dependable technologist who enjoys a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholders across Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

• Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support for employees via Slack, Jira, and other channels. Proactively troubleshoot, document, and resolve issues. Provisions and delivers technology equipment and manages tech onboarding and offboarding for employees.

• Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge with experience and background. Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).

• Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM). Own improvements on identity and access management (IDP/SSO with GSuite, Okta, etc.). Write clear solutions and help articles; automate repetitive tasks. Manage incidents to resolution; handle help desk tickets with effective prioritization. Participate in project work across sprints using Jira and Agile methods. Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

• Lead and contribute to IT infrastructure initiatives across multiple teams and time zones; ensure reliable IT support for a global workforce.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; API integration experience.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; ability to handle hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically; strong writing skills for tickets, email, or Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise writing; sensitivity to different cultures; commitment to security (knowledge of PGP).
  • Networking fundamentals and troubleshooting across OSI layers; ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; ability to adapt to ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth setting. We provide a comprehensive total rewards package, including ownership via equity and remote work flexibility (up to 180 days per year, subject to restrictions). Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response as part of our selection process. No agencies or recruiters, and we do not accept unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance — combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location and benefits — Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona; flexible parental leave benefits; opportunities for cross-functional growth and collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Marketing and Sales
  • Industries: Advertising Services

Overview

INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role supports Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on NetSuite experience, and enjoys a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within NetSuite.

Location: Remote (EST work hours preferred). Remote work opportunity is offered as part of the role.

What we offer: professional development opportunities, a collaborative team environment, and participation in company initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • NetSuite Accounting Data Management: Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite; ensure completeness and accuracy of all entries across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll; conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues; support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.
  • Testing & System Validation: Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules; validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll; perform UAT during NetSuite updates or enhancements; work with Accounting, Finance, and IT to identify and troubleshoot system errors or configuration gaps; help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Month-End & Operational Support: Support the month-end close by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite; assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports; ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.
  • Documentation & Internal Support: Maintain accurate documentation of NetSuite processes, data input standards, and workflows; assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues; contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls; perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.

About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedule that are directly aligned with customer needs.

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.

  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.

What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries

What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.

At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. Overview

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by over 280 million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Company Overview: Simpaul is 100% a Binance Company. The M&A was fully approved by the Brazilian Central Bank in December 2024. This strategic acquisition strengthens our presence in the Brazilian market and enhances our capabilities in the fintech sector.

Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance & Accounting Specialist.

This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, in alignment with both local regulatory requirements and Binance’s global standards. You will be the main point of contact for accounting, tax, and regulatory matters, supporting the business in a fast-paced and high-growth environment.

Note: This role is 100% Remote, Work From Home based. Working Visa is not sponsored.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the month-end and year-end closing processes in accordance with local Brazilian regulations — particularly Receita Federal and Banco Central do Brasil — while ensuring compliance with Binance’s global finance policies.
  • Collaborate closely with the internal finance team to manage accounting and financial processes, ensuring accurate and timely accounting and tax closing.
  • Act as the primary liaison with the external accounting firm, monitoring deliverables, service quality, and outcomes.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Finance/Accounting in implementing upcoming cryptoasset regulations in Brazil, advising on impacts, requirements, and execution plans.
  • Monitor, analyze, and ensure accurate and timely submission of all regulatory reports to authorities such as the Banco Central do Brasil and Receita Federal do Brasil (e.g., CADOCs, statutory financial and tax filings).
  • Develop and maintain the company’s accounting, operational, and capital policies in line with current regulations, business needs, and Binance’s strategic directives (e.g., capital adequacy policies vs. transaction accounting).
  • Track and interpret changes in laws, resolutions, and regulatory instructions related to brokerage and payment activities, ensuring ongoing compliance and regulatory security.
  • Oversee and support all tax-related initiatives, including compliance with tax obligations, implementation of tax reform changes, and corporate reorganization or optimization projects.
  • Lead external audit activities, ensuring alignment with both regulatory requirements and Binance’s internal policies and practices.
  • Drive and support system implementation projects and the launch of new products, focusing on financial and accounting requirements.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the company on business process development, monitoring, and continuous improvement (e.g., internal audit, internal controls, policy updates).
  • Support Binance’s regional Finance and Treasury teams with inquiries, process adjustments, and compliance initiatives to align reporting and operations with corporate policies (e.g., consolidated results reporting).

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in Controllership, Accounting Management, or Finance for banking, payment, or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Strong knowledge in accounting, finance, financial operations, cash management, tax, and payment processes.
  • Proven experience in financial products, financial back-office operations, and banking relationship management.
  • Previous exposure to core banking systems (preferred).

Why Binance

  • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our growing data team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines and architectures on Azure, while working with a variety of analytics and data integration tools. This role will be instrumental in supporting data-driven decision-making across multiple business units by ensuring our data infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and efficient.

  • Implement and manage dbt (Data Build Tool) transformations to create modular, testable, and maintainable data models.

  • Optimize and manage data warehouses and data lakes to support reporting, analytics, and machine learning workloads.

  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security across the entire data ecosystem.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake, Functions, Logic Apps).

  • Expertise in SQL and experience with Azure SQL and SQL Server.

  • Proficiency with dbt for data modeling and transformation.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Desenvolvemos pessoas para impulsionar organizações!

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is a highly motivated, dependable technologist who wants to be part of a fast moving and execution-oriented team.

The role involves designing, implementing and managing our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks; collaborating with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR); and being a strong communicator and fast learner in a supportive environment for IT growth. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Overview

You will be customer-facing, the first line of support, own support, and provide an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We primarily work on Mac environments. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment and will own the onboarding and offboarding tech experience. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management. You will work on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.), document solutions, and automate routine tasks. You will manage incidents, juggle help desk tickets, and participate in projects over sprints with Jira and Agile methods. You will set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

Responsibilities

  • Provide end-user support and own the employee technology experience (Mac-focused environment).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; manage onboarding and offboarding processes.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge base.
  • Manage SaaS applications: Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Administer Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Manage identity and access, IDP/SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Write clear solutions and help articles; automate routine tasks.
  • Lead and participate in projects with Agile methods and Jira tracking.
  • Handle critical incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets effectively.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and cross-functional teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR).

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations (bash, zsh, Python) and use open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; API integration between systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; ability to convey ideas clearly and empathetically.
  • Security awareness, basic networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching) and OSI troubleshooting methodology.
  • Self-management skills with ability to scope projects, prioritize, and work across multiple teams.
  • Willingness to work in a remote-first environment and adapt to ambiguity in a high-growth setting.
  • Nice to have: AWS familiarity; GAM, command-line fluency; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Benefits & Culture

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership through equity; remote work up to 180 days worldwide (subject to restrictions).
  • Purpose-driven work in a global, remote-first company; emphasis on inclusivity and diversity.
  • Accommodation for recruitment process available; confidential handling of requests.

Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Retail

  • Identificar as não conformidades e garantir a abertura das Notificações do NSP;
  • Realizar a admissão do paciente e evolução diária, preenchendo corretamente o impresso de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) para pacientes que irão internar e permanecer por mais de 6 horas no setor, antes de ser encaminhado ao setor de internação;
  • Assistir ao paciente diretamente, principalmente os mais graves, atendendo a todas as suas necessidades básicas afetadas, promovendo condições adequadas para seu repouso e recuperação;
  • Realizar os procedimentos técnicos de maior complexidade, de competência do enfermeiro, como curativos, cateterismos vesical, sondagem vesical, nasogástrica e nasoentérico, não podendo ser delegado aos técnicos, lembrando-se de registrar tudo corretamente na evolução do paciente;
  • Aprazar a prescrição médica, obedecendo à padronização determinada, observando que sejam obedecidos todos os cuidados;
  • Preparar e instalar os drippings dos pacientes, delegando essa função à equipe técnica somente na presença de eventualidades;
  • Encaminhar aos setores responsáveis, pedido de exames e autorização de materiais especiais, devidamente protocolados;
  • Informar ao médico plantonista as intercorrências que venham a ocorrer com o paciente ou com a terapêutica adotada;
  • Atender situações de urgência e emergência, identificando sinais de deterioração clínica;
  • Chamar equipe médica e fisioterapeuta para o atendimento e situações emergenciais; com o médico na realização de exames e tratamentos;

  • Supervisionar o acompanhamento do paciente até o Centro Cirúrgico, caso este necessite de intervenção cirúrgica;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o quarto no momento da alta para a Unidade de Internação/Centro de Terapia Intensiva, passando o plantão para o integrante da equipe de enfermagem responsável;

description:
ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Realizar avaliações com equipe multiprofissional, emitir laudos e encaminhamentos para crianças com suspeita de autismo;

Realizar avaliação, triagem e encaminhamento para as terapias necessárias para os pacientes das reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Auxiliar na construção do Projeto Terapêutico Singular dos pacientes, a ser desenvolvido por equipe multiprofissional;

Prescrever medicamentos e realizar os ajustes necessários das dosagens para os pacientes absorvidos pelas reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Realizar consultas de acompanhamento para os pacientes das reabilitações neurológica pediatrica e intelectual pediatrica;

Realizar renovação de laudos;

Evoluir os atendimentos em prontuário eletrônico.

Ensino Superior em Medicina;

Residência ou título de especialista em neurologia pediátrica;

Responsibilities

  • Building, modifying, and executing detailed test plans, test cases, and scripts to validate application functionality. This includes covering both positive and negative scenarios to ensure comprehensive test coverage.

  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  • Contribute to process improvements in testing methodologies, tools, and best practices to enhance team efficiency and product quality.
  • SQL: Proficient in writing complex SQL queries to validate data integrity and support backend testing. Ability to analyze and manipulate data sets to verify application behavior.
  • Oracle PL/SQL: Strong experience with Oracle PL/SQL for database testing, including writing and executing stored procedures, functions, and triggers to validate business logic at the database level.
  • Microsoft Excel: Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, particularly with functions like VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, to analyze test data, compare results, and generate reports efficiently.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Test Plan features for managing test cases, executing tests, logging defects, and tracking progress within an Agile environment.
  • Manual Testing: Expertise in manual functional testing, including designing test cases, executing tests, and validating application features against requirements.
  • Functional Testing: Deep understanding of functional testing principles to ensure that software behaves as expected under various conditions.
  • Scrum: Active participation in Agile Scrum ceremonies, with a solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the ability to work effectively in iterative development cycles.
  • Defect Management: Skilled in identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects to resolution, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ultra Edit: Familiarity with Ultra Edit or similar advanced text editors to review and analyze code snippets, logs, or configuration files during testing.
  • PeopleSoft HCM: Experience with PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, understanding core modules and workflows to better test related applications.
  • Benefits Module: Knowledge of Benefits modules within PeopleSoft or similar HR systems to validate features related to employee benefits administration.
  • Payroll Module: Understanding of Payroll modules and processes to effectively test payroll-related functionalities and integrations.

About LEDN

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Combating these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.
  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to do work more efficiently.

Culture Fit

  • We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • Remote work eligibility: up to 180 days work-from-anywhere per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job and a culture that removes barriers so you love what you do.

Working Environment & Equal Opportunity

Ledn is truly global with employees across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote-first environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

The role reports to the Director of IT and involves working closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams such as Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This is a customer-facing, first-line support role where you own the support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We are a Mac environment.

Responsibilities

  • Be the first line of support for employees; own support experience via Slack, Jira, and related tools.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Mac endpoints; procure and deliver technology equipment; onboard new employees and retrieve equipment from departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM/Jamf).
  • Improve identity and access management (IDP/SSO) integrations (GSuite, Okta).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents and issues to completion; prioritize help desk tickets and balance them with project work.
  • Contribute to projects using agile methods and sprints (Jira); set and track objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across teams and maintain customer-focused IT service delivery.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, and similar languages.
  • Experience with open source tools (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; ability to handle shipping/receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and ability to craft clear help articles; ability to manage projects and self-direct priorities.
  • Fundamental networking knowledge and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model).
  • Self-management and ability to scope projects and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; comfortable navigating ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to haves: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM/command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

  • Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability in a startup/tech environment, collaborative across functions, and empathy in cross-cultural contexts.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO; equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-friendly: opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Inclusive, diverse workplace and equal opportunity employer; accommodations available during recruitment.

You may reach out for accommodation requests at any stage of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team and may contact only qualified applicants due to high application volume. No agencies or recruiters, and we do not sponsor unsolicited resumes.

title: ENFERMEIRO EMERGÊNCIA -  HOSPITAL CASA DE PORTUGAL(PJ)
description:
Resumo da vaga

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores. Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como ENFERMEIRO EMERGÊNCIA , proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e carinho com seus processos de trabalho.

Principais atividades

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades executadas pela Gerência e Coordenação de Enfermagem;
  • Respeitar a hierarquia do Organograma da Enfermagem e da instituição;
  • Exercer a função assistencial e administrativa, educativa, de pesquisa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Participar das reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, CIPA, CCIH, Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição;
  • Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor, buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Atender as necessidades da equipe de enfermagem, orientando-os e supervisionando, e dos pacientes, priorizando pelo grau de dependência;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da CCIH, de acordo com os POPs;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão, leito a leito, com prontuários em ordem, incluindo itens como identificação, medicação verificada, alterações de material, exames realizados e anotações claras;
  • Realizar a cada plantão o registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências, descrevendo o quantitativo de equipe, preenchendo o checklist, anotando intercorrências e informações relevantes;
  • Ler o Livro de Ocorrências diariamente;
  • Assegurar conformidade com as metas do NSP (Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente) e abrir Notificações quando houver não conformidades;
  • Realizar a admissão do paciente e evolução diária, preenchendo corretamente o SAE para pacientes que permanecerão por mais de 6 horas no setor, antes de encaminhar para internação;
  • Abordar o paciente diretamente, principalmente os mais graves, atendendo a todas as suas necessidades básicas, promovendo condições adequadas para repouso e recuperação;
  • Realizar procedimentos técnicos de maior complexidade, de competência do enfermeiro (curativos, cateterismo vesical, sondagens vesical e nasogástrica/nasoentérica), registrando tudo na evolução do paciente;
  • Aprazar a prescrição médica, obedecendo à padronização determinada e aos cuidados necessários;
  • Preparar e instalar drips, delegando para a equipe técnica apenas na presença de eventualidades;
  • Encaminhar exames e autorizar materiais especiais aos setores responsáveis, conforme protocolo;
  • Informar ao médico plantonista as intercorrências ocorridas com o paciente ou com a terapêutica adotada;
  • Atender situações de urgência e emergência, identificando sinais de deterioração clínica;
  • Chamar equipe médica e fisioterapeuta para atendimento e situações emergenciais, com o médico no acompanhamento de exames e tratamentos;
  • Dar informações ao paciente quanto à terapêutica e aos exames solicitados;
  • Certificar o uso correto da pulseira de identificação e realizar a identificação do paciente;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o setor de Radiologia e assisti-lo durante a realização de todo o exame;
  • Supervisionar o acompanhamento do paciente até o Centro Cirúrgico, se houver necessidade de intervenção cirúrgica;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até o quarto no momento da alta para a Unidade de Internação/Centro de Terapia Intensiva, passando o plantão para o integrante da equipe de enfermagem responsável.

Perfil desejado

  • Nível superior em Enfermagem
  • Desejável experiência de 6 meses na função
  • Especialização na área de Emergência
  • Mediação de conflitos, procedimentos de enfermagem BLS, ACLS
  • Pacote Office

Benefícios

  • Refeição no Local
  • Salário R$ 4.100,00 - PJ

Horário de trabalho

Escala 12x36 SD (7h às 19h)

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst to our Marketing B2B team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Marketing Data Analyst is an embedded analyst position that plays a key role in transforming marketing data into dashboards and reports that drive strategic decisions across marketing initiatives. This role's primary responsibility is to support Insights Managers by preparing clean, accurate, and repeatable data assets and reports. The analyst will transform business questions and challenges into queries and dashboards, ensuring that the data product ecosystem is robust and consistent for others to consume. This key player shapes marketing strategy through targeted data products, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating across teams to enable data-driven insights.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Data Preparation: Translate business or insight questions into queries, reports, and/or dashboards, and collaborate with Insights Managers on how we want to give visibility to this data (understanding the “why” and the business challenge)
  • Dashboard Creation: Build and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor performance metrics.
  • Data Governance: Ensure the consistent usage of concepts, metrics, and KPI definitions across our data products.
  • Quality Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability in our dashboards by proactively detecting possible data deviations and working with Analytics Engineers to resolve them. Develop new business quality tests for new data products.
  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Collaborate with the Global Analytics team to ensure a robust data product ecosystem and consistent reporting methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Relationship: Collaborate closely with Insights Managers and business stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure analytics deliverables align with their objectives.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

For this specific role, please note that prior experience with Tableau, Metabase, Python or SQL and advanced english are mandatory requirements.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and enjoys helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, and be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do / Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support via channels like Slack and Jira, delivering an outstanding experience for employees. All team members are on macOS.
  • Procuring and delivering technology equipment; owning the onboarding experience for new employees and the retrieval process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate recurring tasks. Manage and resolve critical incidents and issues as needed, from inception to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets and prioritize effectively; work on projects over sprints and document work in Jira (familiar with Agile methods and sprints).
  • Set and work toward personal objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; know-how to work with APIs and integrate systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of shipping/receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; ability to explain ideas clearly and assist users who may be frustrated or time-poor;
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication, sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with knowledge of PGP; understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); methodical OSI-model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across teams.

Nice to Haves Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit We look for a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values: integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy; able to work in a remote environment and influence across functions with clarity and empathy.

The Offer / What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and opportunity for remote work worldwide up to 180 days.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company via equity; built-in opportunities for remote work and travel flexibility.
  • A purpose-driven role with a focus on inclusion, diversity, and equal opportunity employment.

Ledn is a global, remote-first company with teams across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We may contact shortlisted candidates for a short video response. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected status.

Location: Sorriso, Mato Grosso, Brazil (candidates may apply globally; this specific listing references a location).

  • Oncology sales experience desired but not required
  • Exceptional probing and consultative communication skills
  • Familiar with oncology providers, drugs, clinic, and hospital communities
  • Understanding of oncology drug reimbursement, Managed Care Medical Specialty and PBM drug benefits
  • Self-motivated and results driven
  • Highly effective in working objectively with a diverse group of people and must demonstrate communication, organizational, administrative and office skills
  • Proficient in data entry, verbal skills, computer skills and the ability to learn the department\'s software system including CRM
  • Must be a team player willing to accept and promote organizational goals and function with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, employees, or senior management.

Finance & FP&A Analyst at LunaJoy Health. This role reports to the Compliance Lead within the Operations (Finance, Compliance, IT) department. Job Title : Finance & FP&A Analyst
Department : Operations (Finance, Compliance, IT)
